title: Save cart for signed-in shoppers
statement: As a signed-in shopper, I want my cart saved across sessions, so that I can finish checkout later.
acceptance: Given items in my cart, when I sign out and back in, then the same items and quantities are in my cart

title: Merge guest cart on sign-in
statement: As a guest shopper, I want my cart kept when I sign in, so that I do not lose what I picked.
acceptance: Given a guest cart and a saved cart, when I sign in, then the carts merge and duplicate items sum their quantities
